annotation.title_clean: Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Digital Omnibus proposals (simplification of the digital legislative framework and AI Act amendments)
annotation.title_en: Commission Staff Working Document accompanying the Digital Omnibus proposals (simplification of the digital legislative framework and AI Act amendments)
annotation.summary_en: Commission staff working document supporting the November 2025 Digital Omnibus proposals. It analyses problems, simplification measures, cost savings and stakeholder views on consolidating the data acquis, GDPR/ePrivacy changes, single-entry incident reporting, targeted AI Act amendments and repeal of the P2B Regulation. The aim is competitiveness without altering underlying objectives.
key_provisions_or_claims: Digital Omnibus could save at least EUR 5 billion for businesses and EUR 1 billion for public authorities by 2029.
Consolidates FFDR, Data Governance Act and Open Data Directive into the Data Act.
Proposes GDPR clarifications on personal data definition, AI training and cookie consent.
Creates a single cybersecurity incident reporting mechanism.
Proposes targeted AI Act amendments, including relief for small mid-caps, and repeals the P2B Regulation.
